text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's, and as I make my way
toward a
shrine near the academy, even
the winter cold
feels somehow new.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From this year, Admire Vega will be
counted
among those in their senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really think she'll be proud of me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I keep running and keep winning...
Then, when
the day comes that I finally
meet her...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: When she finally sees me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do you think she'll be proud?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she lost something of great
importance,
she gained a small seed of
hope. And I want to
continue to support
her as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue thinking as I get in the line to
pray for
success when...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega turns my way. She had
been staring
in the shrine's direction but
for some reason
refrained from joining
the line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze then wanders off elsewhere, as
if
something's made her nervous.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a proper, textbook greeting. At least
she's
being considerate...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I can't think of anything...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You know...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how long she's been
standing there,
but she must be getting
cold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to take her somewhere warm so
we can
talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the New Year's crowds, we
manage to get
a table in a cafe nearby.
Only problem is the
inside is just as noisy
and bustling as outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega mutters a few words just
barely
audible among the surrounding
commotion.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking, I need to live my life
properly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's what she told me at the end... It's
not
about atoning for wrongdoings.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to grant her wish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the center of Admire Vega's world
sits her
sister. That's never changed since
we first met.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I have noticed a few changes
these past
two years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not everything she does now is in
devotion to her
sister's wish.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why... to live my life properly, I
think I have
to start by making a New
Year's resolution like
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But... I can't...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I can't think of anything I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to disappear. Until now, that's
all I
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wanted to dedicate my all to her, until there would be nothing left to give.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Anything less and I wouldn't be doing
right by
her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Everything not related to running... I had to ignore everything I ever wanted.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I lived my whole life looking away,
ignoring it
all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And now, I have no idea what to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She appears to be overthinking things.
Or
perhaps, this is just the usual Admire
Vega having
trouble understanding her
own emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I heard, her resolution has
already
been made clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You might... be right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we make our way back to the
shrine. Even
in the afternoon, the crowd
shows no sign of
letting up. The line
moves forward at a snail's
pace...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that might be for the best, at
least for
Admire Vega, who walks
awkwardly along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, when her turn finally comes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her lead, I close my eyes and
clap my
hands together to make my
wish. "May this year
see Admire Vega..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's done. Time to get back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hm? I don't have that kind of time—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll try... as best as I can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's done. Time to get back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to do that. So...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's done. Time to get back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Relax?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No. You... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can come up with
something...
